hooks.command: exec 2>/dev/null; IN=$(cat); D="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/mods-data/mod-wrap-up/bridge"; S=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); [ -n "$S" ] && mkdir -p "$D" && printf '%s\n' "$IN" >> "$D/$S.jsonl" && find "$D" -name '*.jsonl' -type f -mtime +7 -exec rm -f {} + >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

exec 2>/dev/null; IN=$(cat); D="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/mods-data/mod-wrap-up/bridge"; S=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); [ -n "$S" ] && rm -f "$D/$S.jsonl" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
